briefing.en: An obstacle may or may not block the middle of the room. Read the range sensor, then choose the route. Your program must work in BOTH situations.
briefing.id: Sebuah rintangan mungkin menghalangi tengah ruangan. Baca sensor jarak, lalu pilih rute. Programmu harus berhasil di KEDUA situasi.

en: robot.scan_distance("right") returns the distance in cm. 10 means blocked right in front of you.
Test both scenarios. Hard-coding one route fails the other.
id: robot.scan_distance("right") mengembalikan jarak dalam cm. 10 berarti terhalang tepat di depan.
Uji kedua skenario. Rute yang ditulis kaku akan gagal di skenario lain.

starter:
# Step forward, then scan to the right.
robot.move("right")
distance = robot.scan_distance("right")
